1708.name: TOOLS
1708.docs: The controls of the toolbox and of the Insert page, in order.

600.name: paste
600.docs:
Adds the copied control to the band in use, a little below and to the right
of where it was, or at a free spot if it came from another band.

2135.name: CenterPane
2135.docs: Design, preview and JSON views of the report.

473.name: Group
473.docs: What a group is grouped by.

1781.name: FieldList
1781.docs: The data source's fields; drag one onto a band, or click to add it to the selected band.

1554.name: DOCK_WIDTH
1554.docs: Width of the docked panels: nine color swatches and their padding.

592.name: add_control
592.docs: Adds a control to `band` and selects it.

938.name: surface
938.docs:
The design surface: bands stacked as on paper, with their controls placed
absolutely. Controls are selected with a click, moved by dragging (also
into another band) and resized from the corner handle; bands are resized
from their bottom edge.

584.name: checkpoint
584.docs: Records the current report for undo (start of a drag).

30.name: prelude
30.docs: What the modules of the designer use, as an application would.

1238.name: DESIGN_IMAGES
1238.docs: The image last decoded for each source: the surface rebuilds often.

603.name: free_spot
603.docs: A free spot for a new control in `band`: below its lowest control.

2692.name: ravenrs_report_designer
2692.docs:
RavenRS Report Designer: an end-user report designer running on the
desktop and in the browser. Pick a template or run the wizard, drag fields
onto bands, edit properties, and preview the paginated result instantly.

676.name: preview
676.docs: The document viewer: renders the report with its data and shows the pages.

1557.name: view_tabs
1557.docs:
The tabs under the document that switch between the design surface, the preview
and the JSON, as tabs of the document.

1330.name: toolbox
1330.docs:
The toolbox down the left side: the pointer, then one button per
control, which drops it into the band in use.

749.name: document
749.docs: Renders the report if it changed since the last call.

2484.name: ExpressionDialog
2484.docs:
The expression editor, opened from an expression's button: the expression with
the report's fields, calculated fields and parameters, applied or dropped as a whole.

595.name: control_has_expression
595.docs: Whether the selected control has an expression to edit.

768.name: props
768.docs: The property grid: edits the selected control, band or the report.

579.name: Editor
579.docs: Everything panels share. Cheap to clone.

1633.name: Column
1633.docs:
A column of the window as tall as the row it is in, so what grows inside it takes
the height left: the toolbox and the docked panels.

1706.name: Tool
1706.docs: A control of the toolbox: its name, its icon and how a new one starts.

598.name: copy_selected
598.docs: Keeps a copy of the selected control for Paste.

1552.name: WIZARD_SOURCES
1552.docs: The data sets the wizard offers, with their row counts.

917.name: control_text
917.docs: A text field over part of the selected control.

763.name: with_editor
763.docs: An expression's field with the button that opens it in the expression editor.

936.name: PAPER
936.docs:
The paper is content, not chrome: it stays light in every theme, so all that
is drawn on it comes from Raven Light.

1236.name: design_text
1236.docs: The text a control shows at design time.

1709.name: insert_tool
1709.docs: Drops a new control into the band in use, at a free spot, and selects it.

601.name: reorder_selected
601.docs: Moves the selected control over the others in its band (`front`), or under them.

47.name: all
47.docs: The bands present in `report`, top to bottom as the designer shows them.

474.name: ExpressionTarget
474.docs: An expression the expression editor can open.

1555.name: ZOOM_LEAST
1555.docs: The least and the most zoom of the design surface.

847.name: Properties
847.docs: The properties of whatever is selected.

393.name: FieldDrag
393.docs: A field being dragged from the field list.

1247.name: ResizeHandle
1247.docs: The corner handle of the selected control: drag to resize.

1093.name: BandGrip
1093.docs: The bottom edge of a band: drag to change its height.

585.name: apply
585.docs: Changes the report without recording an undo step (during a drag).

1993.name: FieldGhost
1993.docs: The floating chip that follows a dragged field.

758.name: pick_image
758.docs:
Asks the user for a PNG or JPEG and hands it over as a `data:` address. In
the browser this is the file dialog; the desktop build has no file dialog
yet, so a picture there comes from a field instead.

604.name: band_at
604.docs: The band under `point` (logical pixels), and the point in band coordinates.

577.name: editor
577.docs:
The designer's shared state: the report being edited, the selection,
undo/redo and the engine.

1331.name: dock
1331.docs:
The panels docked on the right: the field list and the report
explorer as tabs on top, the properties below, with a bar to drag between them.

1704.name: print_report
1704.docs: Renders the report as it stands and sends it to the printer.

569.name: expression
569.docs: The expression open in the expression editor, and the text being edited.

942.name: POINTS_PER_CM
942.docs: Report units (points) in a centimeter, the unit the rulers count in.

761.name: FORMATS
761.docs: Formats offered in the format picker, with the format string they use.

680.name: RenderCache
680.docs: The last render, reused while the report and parameters do not change.

2415.name: ZoomBar
2415.docs: The zoom at the right of the status bar: out, a slider, in and the percentage.

599.name: cut_selected
599.docs: Copies the selected control and deletes it.

1553.name: TOOLBOX_WIDTH
1553.docs: Width of the toolbox: one column of icon buttons.

1326.name: embedded
1326.docs:
A designer of this report inside an application, with no gallery or wizard: the layout is
what it is about, with the data embedded in it for the field list and the preview.
`on_save` gets the report as it stands, and `on_close` is for leaving.

945.name: resolved
945.docs: The style a control shows with: its named style, then its own settings.

2553.name: Gallery
2553.docs: The template gallery shown at start, as commercial designers do.

310.name: Selection
310.docs: What is selected on the design surface.

56.name: key
56.docs: A stable number for widget keys.

583.name: edit_as
583.docs:
Changes the report; consecutive edits of the same `kind` (typing in one
property) form one undo step.

756.name: export
756.docs:
Exports the document and hands the file to the user: a download on the web,
or the program that opens the format on the desktop.

302.name: bands
302.docs: Addressing the bands of a report in design order.

2064.name: Shortcuts
2064.docs: Undo, redo and delete from the keyboard.

602.name: target_band
602.docs: The band to insert new controls into: the selected one, else the detail.

575.name: band_frames
575.docs: Frames of the band bodies in the last paint, for drops.

748.name: now_ms
748.docs: Milliseconds from a monotonic clock, on desktop and in the browser.

594.name: expression_of
594.docs: The text of an expression, empty if there is none.

567.name: copied
567.docs: The control last copied or cut, for Paste.

86.name: into
86.docs: Calls `U::from(self)`. That is, this conversion is whatever the implementation of [From]<T> for U chooses to do.

2275.name: JsonPane
2275.docs: The report definition as JSON, with long sample data abbreviated.

940.name: CAPTION_HEIGHT
940.docs: Height of a band's caption strip, which the vertical ruler leaves blank.

1921.name: field_control
1921.docs: A new field control with a sensible format for its kind.

586.name: load
586.docs: Replaces the whole report (a template, a loaded file).

578.name: last_edit
578.docs: The kind of the last edit, so typing in one field is one undo step.

1559.name: FillRow
1559.docs:
A row that takes the space left and never grows past it, so the panels
inside scroll instead of pushing the status bar off the window.

1705.name: export_report
1705.docs: Renders the report as it stands and exports it.

597.name: apply_expression
597.docs: Writes the expression being edited and closes the editor.

470.name: Control
470.docs: The selected control's expression: a field, a barcode's or a bookmark's.

1324.name: new
1324.docs: A designer showing the sales report, with the template gallery open.

943.name: DOCUMENT_INK
943.docs: What the report engine prints when a control sets no color.

1924.name: BandList
1924.docs: The report explorer: bands in order, click to select.

1316.name: Embedded
1316.docs: What the designer says and does inside an application, in place of its gallery and wizard.

762.name: PALETTE
762.docs:
Text colors and fills offered as swatches: Raven Light tokens, since they are
printed on white paper.

54.name: title
54.docs: The band's name, as the designer shows it.

581.name: edit
581.docs: Changes the report as one undoable step.

2343.name: themes
2343.docs: Whether it offers the themes, which are the application's to say inside one.
